why_agent_cannot: enter an email and click the confirmation link
what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the Leap site Go to leap.xyz and read the homepage sections on daily news, markets and portfolio profit and loss.
2 Step 2 : Review the asset range Look at the markets the homepage lists: tokenized stocks, ETFs, commodities, currencies and crypto. This shows what the app is built to trade.
3 Step 3 : Join the waitlist Open the Leap waitlist and join the Founders Club waitlist the homepage describes, next to its early access notice.
